description_sq:
PER shitje apartamente 1+1, ne kompleksin me te ri rezidencial Lugano Residences, 
ne zonen e Ali Demit, Prane Kryegjyshates Boterore Bektashiane.
Kjo rezidence sjell nje stil te ri, modern dhe te shendetshem te te jetuarit.
Ndertimi ndahet ne dy faza. Faza e pare, ne te cilen vijne dhe apartamentet per shitje, perfundon ne dy vite e gjysme.
Mundesi pagese me keste.
description_en: FOR sale 1+1 apartments, in the newest residential complex Lugano Residences, in the area of ​​Ali Demi, near the Bektashia World Grand Duchess. This residence brings a new, modern and healthy style of living. The construction is divided into two phases. The first phase, which includes the apartments for sale, will be completed in two and a half years. Possibility of payment in installments.
